name: English Morphology Composite Textpack
description: Generated source-backed English morphology recipe composite for SCOWLv2 lookup analyzer and generator resources.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated recipe composite over the publishable SCOWLv2 lookup morphology component, which provides form-to-lemma lookup analysis, lemma-to-form generation candidates, morphology tables, POS inventory, canonical morphology metadata, and generated evaluation records.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: The SCOWLv2 source row is approved; the required component package carries package-local copyright evidence.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: English lookup morphology component composite backed by SCOWLv2 POS and inflection resources. It claims deterministic form-to-lemma lookup analysis and lemma-to-form generation candidates over the pinned SCOWLv2 release. It does not claim finite-state analysis, context disambiguation, syntax parsing, corpus-frequency morphology, UniMorph coverage, corpus coverage, parallel coverage, or full language-composite coverage.
